quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Tezspire positive results from Phase III CROSSING trial in (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Full Phase III CROSSING results for Tezspire (tezepelumab, with Amgen) in eosinophilic esophagitis, presented as a late-breaker at UEG Week 2026: histologic remission at week 24 in 64.8% (210mg) and 68.9% (420mg) of patients versus 3.5% on placebo (p<0.001), and dysphagia (DSQ) reductions of 18.8 points (210mg; p=0.049) and 22.0 points (420mg; p<0.001) versus 14.7 on placebo; at week 52, histologic remission 67.8% and 63.3% versus 5.4%, DSQ reductions of 22.1 and 24.0 points versus 13.2, and total endoscopic remission 34.4% and 29.5% versus 4.1% (p<0.001). AstraZeneca calls Tezspire the first and only biologic to reach these outcomes and will share the data with regulatory authorities.
quarterly_data.figure: histologic remission 64.8% and 68.9% vs 3.5% placebo at week 24
